entities.title: Adult Yeti
entities.description:
A fully grown Adult Yeti can tower at almost 8 meters tall. Its white fur offers perfect camouflage in the snowy, frozen environment.

Adult Yetis are sought after for their two fangs - unfortunately very brittle, and therefore rare.

While they pose great danger in close combat, they can be susceptible to arrow attacks.

entities.title: Anubis Warrior
entities.description:
This mythical giant uses crude tools and swords to attack unsuspecting victims. It has been known to set traps along common caravan routes and it appears to hunt for sport, not simply food.

While associated with a god in name and appearance, there is no evidence there is any advanced intelligence or particular strength of this giant. It's a fierce enemy, but not a divine agent.

entities.title: Archdemon
entities.description:
Facing this giant is no small feat. When you bend down to stare at the Archdemon face to face, you'll be overwhelmed by the massive loathing in its eyes.

The Archdemon is largely underrated, both in its giant-sized power and its colossal strength.

Monstrous in its appearance (and smell), the Archdemon is big on terror. Use downstrokes to deal the most damage.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322

entities.title: Bat
entities.description:
The Bat hunts large mammals, utilizing its three meter wingspan and terrifyingly wide jaws.

The Bat thrives in the dark and has an uncanny anticipation of movement, causing victims to feel like the Bat can predict the future.

When fighting, move in unpredictable patterns and ground the Bat with a strike to the wings.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322

entities.title: Carniplant
entities.description:
Growing in dense, humid environments, the Carniplant is rooted and therefore appears deceptively safe. Avoid it at all costs.

It sways gently to lure its prey close, and then attacks swiftly, locking its victims into place with strong jaws. Victims tend to die over days, and then are consumed.

Thankfully, this plant grows slowly and is fairly rare.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Cobra
entities.description:
Averaging three meters long, the massive Cobra is a cunning predator, easily able to take down large animals or wreak havoc on trade routes or nomadic desert dwellers.

Capable of living for more than a month without water, Cobras are often found in isolated dunes, meaning even the emptiest parts of the desert are full of danger.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Cursed Tree
entities.description:
Though smaller than might be expected, these enemies are devastating to the surrounding areas.

They are incredibly hard to cut down, and Cursed Trees poison everything within their root reach. Crops, feeding livestock, well or natural water sources, and natural foliage will all be destroyed around the tree.

Cursed Trees are an invasive species - aggressively remove.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Demon
entities.description:
Beware the demon - they are neither as cute nor as quiet as they appear.

They look innocent, but they are highly intelligent and often try to trick their prey into getting closer with their adorable appearance. They then fly into a devilish rage, attacking with teeth, claws, and horns.

Do not consider keeping Demons for pets.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Fairy Queen
entities.description:
Do not fall prey to the Fairy Queen's quaint appearance or storybook charm. She is a giant of fierce manipulation, cunning, and guile.

Surprisingly, the Fairy Queen is a member of the arachnid family, and spins an outer layer, almost like fabric, that is prized for its durability and warmth.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Frozen Spirit
entities.description:
The Frozen Spirits are creatures born from souls that have been trapped in ice for countless years.

Over time, the intense cold and isolation caused these souls to merge, forming a new life. These beings are made of ice and spirit, moving slowly but with great purpose. While they are not fast, their presence brings a chilling aura that saps the warmth and life from those who approach.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Funkloud
entities.description:
These enigmatic creatures groove to their own beat. Their siren song draws in unsuspecting victims who are then overwhelmed by the jazzy tunes and die as a result of exhausting dancing and disco.

Like Star Notes, however, their motives are unknown. Are they evil? Or are they just really, really groovy?

entities.title: Funky Speaker
entities.description:
No one knows how the Speaker evolved, or the nature of its vibe. But its bebop is unmistakable.

With thunderous bass and trilling trebels, the Funky Speaker is devastating to ear drums, sanity, and even structures. It's believed to feed off the vibe of those who come near.

Thankfully, the Funky Speaker doesn't move, remaining where it's jamming, bopping to its own beat.

provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Giant Gorilla
entities.description:
Despite its terrifying size and glowing red eyes, most believe the Giant Gorilla was peaceful until someone refused to pass its banana.

Stay clear of its reach - the Giant Gorilla is incredibly strong.

Revered by a strange sect known as the Banana Gang, this giant is the only known enemy to have developed god-like status. Slay with discretion.

provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Hills' Giant
entities.description:
The Hills' Giant is a menace to the idyllic countryside many call home.

Impressively tall, and with a solid titanium core, the Hills' Giant lies dormant for years until suddenly surging out of the rockside and destroying anything in its path.

When challenging a Hills' Giant, choose a stout sword and be prepared for an extended fight.

provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Ice Wraith
entities.description:
A flying terror, the Ice Wraith was once thought extinct. Population size has skyrocketed recently, and they now pose a threat to travel and commerce.

Relentlessly aggressive, the Ice Wraith will attack creatures many times its size. While a pack animal, they have a short lifespan and spawn, aggressively hunt, reproduce, and then die.

entities.title: Jelly
entities.description:
The innocent looking Jelly can flow into different shapes, making them an adept hunter.

Their true danger is in their stickiness. Light contact will glue them to skin, which they start digesting immediately.

As the prey attempts to shake them off, the Jelly is drawn towards the victim, slowly engulfing and consuming them.

entities.title: King Goblin
entities.description:
Like its cousin the Soul Goblin, little is known of this portly fellow. While the King Goblin doesn't appear threatening, it tends to mass along the most grueling sections in the Soul World, perhaps feeding off of lost soul energy.

Strangely, there is no explanation for its crown, which seems to be a genetic evolution rather than external jewelry.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322

entities.title: Mimic
entities.description:
The shapeshifting mimic feeds on gold and hides within Chest Hunts. These terrifying enemies will eagerly devour Slayers foolish enough to touch one.

If attempting to survive an encounter, your best chance is a defensive counterattack. It is reported a surprise hit can slay a mimic, but your best option is to avoid them.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Mushroom
entities.description:
Many mushrooms are dangerous because they're poisonous if eaten. These mushrooms, however, are covered with a thin coat of paralyzing venom.

Following the paralysis of anything that touches it, the mushroom will feast as the body decomposes.

To counteract, move quickly and avoid exposure to the mushroom cap.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Scorpion
entities.description:
Scorpions are hunted relentlessly. While most hunters are wary of the quick tail and barbed stinger, it's easy to forget how dangerous the claws are themselves.

Scorpions use their claws to rip at enemies, tearing flesh and limbs. The pincers are made from a firm, fleshy material which, as many know, is a delicious addition to any stew.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Soul Barrel
entities.description:
Be very careful around Soul Barrels. While seeming innocent, they leak the residual pain and loss of the violently harvested lives.

People who have spent even limited time near poorly sealed soul barrels have become depressed and have been found without a will to live any longer.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Soul Goblin
entities.description:
Soul Goblins almost never venture into the Mortal world, choosing to stay instead in the Soul World. Little is known of the origin, purpose, or role of these creatures. It is theorized they were once guardians - but of what?

A pack creature, they survive off of lost beings in the Soul World.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Souls Tank
entities.description:
Years ago, during experiments with a highly reactive soul mixture at high pressures, a horrific reaction led to this infectious, living ooze.

Unfortunately, the tank chosen to contain this creation both protects it from oxygen and acts as an armored shell. Even contained, Soul Tank's are able to feed on the energy of anything nearby. To kill it, break the tank and expose it to air.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Star Note
entities.description:
The nature of the Funky Space creatures is mysterious.

Star Notes seem to move at very high frequencies, and many feel they give off good vibrations. But everything close to a Star Note can be destroyed by the waves of groovy energy they blast.

Whenever visiting Funky Space, ensure your ears are guarded from their fly tunes.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Toxic Gas
entities.description:
A byproduct of the soul mining done at the factory, this gas contains fairly rich soul residue.

However, it tends to be saturated in evil as a result of the mining process. Individuals caught in toxic gas quickly become overwhelmed and in turn kill those around them.

It must be destroyed.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Vulture
entities.description:
Although scavengers, Vultures prefer to kill their own prey, repeatedly attacking from above and then leaving once the casualty is incapacitated. The Vulture then returns after a few days to feed on the carcass.

If attacked, either seek cover or strike at the throat - other places are well guarded by the Vulture's quick, sharp talons.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Wasp
entities.description:
A flying terror, the Wasp attacks with its viciously long, poisoned stinger and incapacitates victims before landing and consuming.

While they usually don't hunt humans, Wasp Swarms can be devastating to crops and livestock, making removing them important.

Avoid the stinger, but attack the underbelly.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322
provenance.evidence: Read-only ResourceManager registry, native English localization and current IL2CPP declarations; data/companion-catalog-receipt.json

entities.title: Wererat
entities.description:
Was each Wererat once a human, changed through diabolical evil into the twisted mutant it now is? Experts are divided.

Actually, experts don't know, because few study the Wererat at all. The Wererat is overly large and a sewer dweller, appalling in appearance, overwhelming in its stench, and vicious in its attack.

If they were active during the day, it's likely Modern City would be uninhabitable.

provenance.label: Installed Idle Slayer 7.3.4 · Steam build 25810322

entities.title: Wildfire
entities.description:
Because this spiritual enemy feeds off its victim's fear, its chief goal is to induce terror.

The wildfire tends to haunt dreams, turning comfortable thoughts into fear-filled nightmares.

Its ability to interact in the Mortal World is limited - therefore, killing it proves a unique challenge.

entities.title: Worm
entities.description:
Almost two meters long, the Worm tends to hunt in packs. They bond to a pack leader and can be fiercely loyal.

Because they burrow, they pose a threat to buildings and trees. Surprisingly, they have also been found in trees, but this is rare.

Do not underestimate this creature. Although slow, they have very sharp teeth. Attack the Worm's soft neck.

entities.title: Young Yeti
entities.description:
There's a popular misconception that Young Yetis are related to the Giant Yeti. Surprisingly, they're entirely different species.

Young Yetis are relentless and intelligent predators. They hunt alone, in groups, and sometimes with other creatures, making them uniquely dangerous.
